title: 05.01 - View or print a contribution after submission
intent: Explain how participants can view or print their contribution immediately after submitting it.
short_answer: Yes. Right after submission, EUSurvey offers a print option on the Confirmation page.
procedure: Use the print option offered on that page.
important_conditions: The print option is available immediately after submission.
If you leave the Confirmation page without printing or saving a copy, you may need your contribution ID for later actions.
